problem: The native Excel metadata workbooks had untested picture, watch/error, consolidation and phonetic-default operation scopes. The XLSX matrix also claimed writers that its current ignored-error and phonetic read models do not expose.
changes: Add nine native-fixture tests across XLS, XLSX and XLSB and index five previously untested bounded feature rows. Strengthen existing XLS consolidation assertions.

Exercise the existing APIs without production changes: detached XLS record codecs, XLSX read models and XML fragment writers, XLSB package watch/phonetic transactions, and unrelated property/scalar publication.
Correct XLSX ignored-error and phonetic write claims and clarify detached watch/consolidation writing. Clarify XLS image/watch codec scope and the absence of native XLSB phonetic defaults.

verification_scope.xls: Native A7 watch flags/bounds, one A4:A5 calculation-error range, stored error/formula values and detached error-check flags round-trip. BkHim joins 21 Continue records into a 172820-byte logical payload containing a 172812-byte 320x180 24-bit bitmap. Both 1905/290-byte HFPicture payloads round-trip, with drawing-kind flags and the embedded PNG boundary pinned. Title publication preserves all other CFB streams and inverse restores original bytes.
verification_scope.xls_consolidation: Sum, top labels and links are present; left labels are false. Two A1:B3 source ranges and six caches 10/5/15/20/7/27 survive unrelated property publication. The native DCon bytes 08 00 00 00 01 00 01 00 differ from the historical audit description; native bytes and the immutable historical inventory are retained.
verification_scope.xlsx: Exactly A4:A5 EvaluationError exclusions and A7 watch are read alongside #VALUE!, #DIV/0! and 30 caches. Detached watch/consolidation XML round-trips in both Strict and Transitional dialects; derivative collections and Average metadata do not modify the source package. Native consolidation has two local A1:B3 sources, left/top labels and links, and six exact formula/cache pairs.
verification_scope.xlsx_publication: A source-backed scalar edit changes Print_015!B2 from 42 to 43. Save/reopen preserves all unrelated worksheet, watch, ignored-error, consolidation, VML and media members exactly, as well as the selected worksheet header/footer fragment. Calculation ownership is invalidated by the existing editor. Inverse restores every original package member.
verification_scope.xlsb: Native A7 watch reads with no opaque collection records; the other four sheets have no watches and all five sheets have no phonetic defaults. Watch add/reorder/remove/clear, duplicate and invalid-sheet staging, forward replay, stale rejection and exact inverse preserve every unowned BIFF record and all other package members.
verification_scope.phonetic_derivative: Litchi-authored Hiragana/Center and AsEntered/Distribute defaults are added, updated, cleared and inverse-restored on the native XLSB workbook, retaining its watch/text/styles/caches. This exercises package editing of an absent native owner; it is not positive evidence of native-authored phonetic content.
verification_scope.limits: No watch monitoring, error diagnosis, consolidation execution, formula recalculation, picture placement/rendering, phonetic language conversion or fresh Excel reopen is claimed. XLS picture/watch/error tests do not establish package CRUD. XLSX ignored errors and phonetic properties remain read-only; cell watches and consolidation have detached fragment writers, not package editors. Source-backed worksheet getters are absent for watches, ignored errors and consolidation.

specification_evidence.finding: fLeftCat=0 identifies source rows by position; fLeftCat=1 uses leftmost row labels. Native XLS stores zero at bytes 2..4, unlike the native XLSX leftLabels=true. The test pins the saved format-specific distinction rather than altering the fixture.
